{{Quote|A small time group known as the Peddlers are a good place to start. According to my sources, Hunnos used to occasionally work as muscle for them when someone didn't pay or supply the promised goods.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />}}
The '''Peddlers''' were a criminal group active on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Sundria Khartoor|Khartoor]] tasked her agents to attack Peddlers near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] in order to gather information about the escaped murderer [[Hunnos Jarkey]].<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Peddlers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Peddlers were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
